reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are more than most TikTok magnesium shows me, and $24.99 for the first box is an easy impulse buy. The empty-box guarantee means I am not stuck if it does nothing for me.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? I would want to know bisglycinate alone does the job.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing the lab report and the box side by side, and a clear reason why bisglycinate alone is enough.
